simple.meaning: צְרִי (tsᵉrîy) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “distillation , i.e. balsam.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 6 times across Genesis, Jeremiah, Ezekiel, beginning at Genesis 37:25. Its contexts include family, family line, land, Egypt, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צְרִי (H6875).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: צְרִי (tsᵉrîy) / H6875 is traced through Genesis 37:25, Genesis 43:11, Jeremiah 8:22, Jeremiah 46:11 as a generated source-based concept entry.

timeline.evidenceText: They sat down to eat bread, and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites was coming from Gilead, with their camels bearing spices and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.

Their father, Israel, said to them, “If it must be so, then do this: Take from the choice fruits of the land in your bags, and carry down a present for the man, a little balm, a little honey, spices and myrrh, nuts, and almonds;
Is there no balm in Gilead?
Go up into Gilead, and take balm, virgin daughter of Egypt.
Babylon has suddenly fallen and been destroyed!
“ ‘ “Judah and the land of Israel were your traders. They traded wheat of Minnith, confections, honey, oil, and balm for your merchandise.

definitions.full: H6875. tsori or tseri or tsori צֳרִי and ( Gen 37:25 ) (וּ)צְרִי noun [masculine] a kind of balsam , as merchandise 37:25 (J), Ezek 27:17 , gift Gen 43:11 (J), medicament Jer 8:22 ; 46:11 ; 51:8 (for national disaster, in fig,); — ThDyerM'Lean in Ency. Bib. Balm think a resin, like (not necess.=) gum of mastic-tree, pistacia lentiscus (otherwise Post Hastings DB ).
definitions.rootNote: or צֳרִי ; from an unused root meaning to crack (as by pressure), hence, to leak;
